question: compute/trumvps reliability_note reads 'trumvps.com returned a broker-side HTTP 530'; can it be restated as 'trumvps.com serves no HTTP site: the domain has no A or AAAA record and www.trumvps.com is NXDOMAIN'?
why: The note describes the broker's failure, not the domain. Today trumvps.com is delegated to ns1.zonedns.vn and answers with an SOA and no address record (probe:https://dns.google/resolve?name=trumvps.com&type=A, capture sha256:4c32f65d1ccf2a63f601e6fc227b295a041f12e73f3f15a96fc6262afae699d3, body 'Status':0 with no Answer section); www.trumvps.com is NXDOMAIN (probe:https://dns.google/resolve?name=www.trumvps.com&type=A, capture sha256:9ebcf53ce352e73fb4cb77323d85d05e3d95b4746d27c4666d4796af6768c076, body 'Status':3); and https://trumvps.com/ fails DNS resolution from this machine (probe:https://trumvps.com/, capture sha256:aea5dc385f65416ee74437f34ce17f70a3839dc59c281f8e11afbd418efa803b, record 'error': 'dns'). The only Wayback capture, 20211225043048, is a domain-for-sale page at sav.com. The unit's scope is new records only, so the field cannot be set here.
